scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const out='build'; fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync('.', { withFileTypes: true })) { if (entry.name === 'build' || entry.name === 'node_modules' || entry.name === '.git') continue; fs.cpSync(path.join('.', entry.name), path.join(out, entry.name), { recursive: true, force: true }); } console.log('Backend build artifact prepared');"
